_meta.title: Benzodiazepines
_meta.source_doc: Bara ICU Dosing Card 2024 / HJH ED 2026

drug.adult_dose: Flumazenil: 0.2mg IV over 15sec, then 0.1mg every 60sec (max 1mg) | Caution: Generally AVOID Flumazenil
drug.notes: AVOID Flumazenil - can precipitate withdrawal/seizures in chronic users or co-ingestions. Supportive care is primary.
